register: Natural Malaysian Malay children's dialogue; conversational forms allowed, not a fully formal classroom text

character.dino.note: kecil is the source's affectionate little-Dino adjective, not a second name. Keep Dino spelling and pronunciation consistent.

character.moon.note: Capital B when addressing/referring to the personified Moon character.

character.cloud.note: Owner confirmed Atuk Awan. Use this name for the character in future episodes; ordinary awan and place Gunung Awan retain their meanings. Current episode has no direct spoken address to the Guardian, so no new dialogue or regeneration is needed.

environment.clouds.note: Ordinary clouds are not the Guardian. Never globally replace awan with the Guardian's proper name.

state.trapped_behind_clouds.note: This is the selected final take. Older terperangkap takes remain archived but are not used in current v007. Other trapping contexts may legitimately need different wording.

action.help_request.note: Polite request use; do not mechanically replace it with bantu.

pronouns.note: Current consistent defaults. Other pronouns may be appropriate when context changes; this is not a grammar ban.

approval_note: Owner confirmed the Malay Guardian name Atuk Awan. Other entries reflect audited current usage; this is not a native-speaker acting approval.
